title: Water polo at Mt. SAC: Mt. SAC vs. Golden West
description: At Mt. SAC's world-class Hilmer Lodge Stadium, Mt. SAC hosts Golden West for water polo. The setting alone makes this worth the trip — and admission is free.

title: Swimming & diving at Occidental: Occidental vs. Claremont-M-S/Redlands
description: At Occidental's gorgeous Eagle Rock campus, Occidental hosts Claremont-M-S/Redlands for swimming & diving. The setting alone makes this worth the trip — and admission is free.

title: Free JuCo Volleyball: PCC vs. LA Mission
description: Want competitive volleyball without spending a dime? PCC takes on LA Mission at PCC Robinson Stadium & Hutto-Patterson Gymnasium. Free admission — just show up.

title: California Cup: Kings vs. Sharks
description: California Cup — need we say more? Crypto.com Arena will be rocking when the Sharks roll in. Don't miss this one.

title: Battle of LA: Rams vs. Los Angeles Chargers
description: One of the best rivalries in football is back. The Los Angeles Chargers visit SoFi Stadium with bragging rights on the line.

title: Crosstown Showdown: USC vs. #14 UCLA
description: Crosstown Showdown — need we say more? Galen Center will be rocking when the #14 UCLA roll in. Don't miss this one.
